metadata.dataset: InSight Marsquake Service (MQS) Catalogue V14 (2,715 events)

hazard_thresholds_pga.label: Safe / Instrumental
hazard_thresholds_pga.advisory: No structural risk. Nominal habitat operations.

hazard_thresholds_pga.label: Minor Shaking
hazard_thresholds_pga.advisory: Slight vibration felt. Check solar array tracking gimbals.

hazard_thresholds_pga.label: Moderate Shaking
hazard_thresholds_pga.advisory: Airlock seal strain possible. Secure loose cabin gear. Slopes >15° unstable.

hazard_thresholds_pga.label: Severe Shaking
hazard_thresholds_pga.advisory: Structural hazard! Foundation settlement risk. Immediate hull integrity scan required.

hazard_thresholds_pga.label: Critical Damage
hazard_thresholds_pga.advisory: EMERGENCY: Exceeds habitat design limits. Pressure hull rupture hazard!

landmarks.name: S1222a
landmarks.title: The Monster Marsquake
landmarks.description: Largest marsquake detected by InSight. Shook the planet for over 10 hours with surface waves circling Mars.

landmarks.name: S0173a
landmarks.title: Cerberus Fossae Graben Rupture
landmarks.description: First clearly located tectonic marsquake directly sourced from the active Cerberus Fossae fault system.

landmarks.name: S0235b
landmarks.title: Cerberus Deep Extensional Event
landmarks.description: High SNR extensional strike-slip faulting in eastern Cerberus Fossae with distinct P and S body phases.

landmarks.name: S1022a
landmarks.title: Amazonis Meteoroid Impact
landmarks.description: Hypervelocity meteorite strike creating a 150m wide impact crater and exposing boulder-sized chunks of pure water ice.
